name: field-work-center-navigation
objective: Make field home/work queue authoritative, assignment-scoped and safe across refresh, stale work and deep-link navigation.
truthOwner: Workforce owns field assignment/readiness; DSH owns field operational work state; app-field renders/composes only.
journeys: field work entry and authorized navigation

tasks.objective: Converge the field work center on current assignment/operational truth and visible stale/offline state.
tasks.currentProblem: Current work queue visibly covers visits and escalations, while complete assignment freshness and pending-sync behavior are not proven.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace the canonical field assignment/work read model and expose only required fields/states, including stale/revoked and pending-sync recovery where applicable.
tasks.targetState: The employee sees only current authorized work and knows whether each actionable record is fresh, blocked, offline-pending or stale.
tasks.action: Fix shared controller/read model first, then app-field presentation; add negative tests for reassignment and stale records.
acceptanceCriteria: Only current assigned/authorized field work is actionable.
Stale/revoked/pending-sync state has deterministic recovery UX.
tasks.rollback: Revert view/read-model changes without restoring stale local truth.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused work-center commit after field tests pass.

tasks.objective: Make field deep links and notification navigation permission-gated, parameter-valid and recoverable.
tasks.currentProblem: Routes are parsed statically; stale/invalid targets still require same-entry authorization and UX proof.
tasks.requiredChange: Validate required IDs and current permission/readiness/assignment at destination entry and resume, with explicit invalid/stale states.
tasks.targetState: A link can navigate but cannot grant authority or strand the employee on an invalid target.
tasks.action: Trace parseDeepLink through route model/renderers/controllers and server read authorization; add initial/resumed/stale-link tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Missing/invalid/stale IDs produce safe recoverable state.
Initial and resumed links preserve correct back/readback behavior.
tasks.rollback: Revert routing change while preserving safe fail-closed handling.
tasks.commitBoundary: Same unit or focused navigation commit.
